[Montreal Tourism office](https://www.mtl.org/en/what-to-do/business-events) has practical information about the city.

## Travel and visa

You may need an [electronic travel authorization (eTA)](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada/eta.html) or a visitor visa. Check this [video](https://youtu.be/aYz9de2Qd_U?list=TLGGbdshJm7bkEQwODA3MjAyNQ) for more details about the application. Please contact the organizing committee if you need a letter for your visa application.

[Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL)](https://www.admtl.com/en-CA/) is well connected with major American and European cities. The airport is easily reached via the [747 bus](https://www.stm.info/en/info/networks/bus-network-and-schedules-enlightened/747-yul-montreal-trudeau-airport-downtown).

## Accommodation

Please note that [Montreal International Jazz Festival](https://montrealjazzfest.com/) runs from June 25th until July 4th. We encourage you to secure your accommodation well in advance, particularly if you plan to attend the short courses over the weekend.


We arranged deals with hotels and student dormitories to offer EVA participants with discounts and affordable options for early career options. We are also currently negotiating with [Campus1 Montreal](https://campus1mtl.ca/montreal-student-housing/).

There are also [numerous hostels, hotels and bed and breakfasts close to downtown](https://www.mtl.org/en/Accommodations?prod_en_random%5BrefinementList%5D%5B_filter_product_neighbourhoods%5D%5B0%5D=Downtown&prod_en_random%5BrefinementList%5D%5B_filter_product_neighbourhoods%5D%5B1%5D=Les%20Quartiers%20du%20Canal&prod_en_random%5BrefinementList%5D%5B_filter_product_neighbourhoods%5D%5B2%5D=Mount%20Royal%2C%20Outremont%20and%20Westmount&prod_en_random%5BrefinementList%5D%5B_filter_product_neighbourhoods%5D%5B3%5D=Old%20Montr%C3%A9al%20and%20Old%20Port).

Payment is due upon arrival, a minimum of 48 hours prior to check-in in case of a cancellation or modification.
 
Check-in/check-out:  All locations are open with 24-hour reception.  Check in is at 3pm and check out is at 11am.  You may leave your luggage with the reception when you check in and when you check out.

Family Plan Policy: Children 12 and under sleep free in existing room bedding configuration. Children over 5 are charged breakfast rate of $16.00 

Cancellation policy: A 48 hour notice is required in writing prior to your arrival date, otherwise the first night (plus taxes) will be charged.

All locations are cashless: you can only pay by Interac or other major credit cards.
